author: Morgan Ealy
title: Auburn experiences lane closures due to sanitary sewer overflow - NewsBreak
text:
By Morgan Ealy ,
2 hours ago
AUBURN, Ala. ( WRBL ) — Lane closures began in Auburn on Wednesday evening around 7 p.m. after a sanitary sewer overflow within the sewer collection system, according to officials.
The lane closures are located on West Magnolia Avenue between Cox Street and Thomas Street.
Credit: City of Auburn According to officials, sewer personnel responded to the overflow, removing the blockage and stopping the discharge.
According to Director of Communications, Allison Blankenship, sewer personnel are making repairs to the sanitary sewer line in the area.
RELATED: Does your Auburn water taste a little… off? Here’s why
Blankenship says the westbound lane and median will remain closed while personnel work on repairs. Residents are encouraged to avoid the area and take alternative routes during this time to prevent any delays.
For further details, please contact the Water Resource Management Department at 334-501-3060 or visit the Auburn Spill Notifications.
